mechanism.claim: During elevated completed realized variation, a strict zero crossing of the official default Hilbert Transform real (InPhase) component marks a causal transition in the detrended price cycle. Follow the new InPhase sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when ready InPhase crosses strictly from <=0 to >0; short when it crosses from >=0 to <0
mechanism.why_distinct: This policy uses the fixed-length LEAN Hilbert FIR real component directly. MAMA uses different Hilbert-style kernels, homodyne period estimation, phase-dependent adaptive alpha, and an adaptive-average crossover; synthetic/sinewave candidates estimate bounded dominant cycles. HVHILBERT has no adaptive period, moving average, fitted outcome, reused event set, volume, flow, OI, or funding.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: a fixed-filter cycle sign transition is admitted only while trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour fixed-Hilbert real-component crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.input: completed four-hour close from exact 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows
features.indicator: exact stateful LEAN HilbertTransform(7,.635,.338) InPhase component
features.event: strict finite zero crossing of consecutive eligible InPhase values; current zero emits no event
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid four-hour decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: bar aggregation, every Hilbert delay/feedback state, crossing state, and variation history reset after any invalid completed source bar

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: official default fixed Hilbert real-component zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no length, factors, update order, component, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John Ehlers Hilbert Transform; QuantConnect LEAN canonical implementation
external_basis.fixed_definition: official defaults length=7, InPhase multiplication=.635, Quadrature multiplication=.338; detrended price is current minus delay7; delayed detrended values and feedback produce InPhase=1.25*(delay4-delay2*.635)+InPhaseDelay3*.635 exactly in LEAN update order
external_basis.readiness: outer WarmUpPeriod=length+2=9, while the InPhase functional component requires Samples>length+2; event eligibility therefore requires ready finite InPhase output after that component predicate and a prior eligible finite value
external_basis.selection_use: official defaults, recursive update order, readiness, and InPhase zero crossing only; no incidence or outcomes
